meta.note: Hand-curated headline figures for the levels above the farm (docs/CONCEPT-v2.md section 4.2). Every value was checked against its source on 2026-10-13; where the concept's figure differed from the source, the source wins and the value's note says so. Official = published by the source; Estimated = our own calculation from open data, or a machine-learning estimate. From v2.1, tools/build-data.mjs refreshes this file. Licences: data/LICENSES.md.

world.farms.label: Farms worldwide
world.farms.source: FAO: Lowder, Arslan, Cabrera Cevallos, O'Neill and De La O Campos, A global update on the number of farms, farm size and farmland distribution (Agricultural Development Economics Working Paper 25-14, background paper for The State of Food and Agriculture 2025)
world.farms.note: About 579 million farms in 2025: FAO's estimate from census data for 152 countries, projected to 2025. It replaces the earlier 'more than 608 million' (FAO 2019), which was built from older counts.

world.smallFarmsShare.label: Farms under 2 ha
world.smallFarmsShare.source: FAO: Lowder, Arslan, Cabrera Cevallos, O'Neill and De La O Campos, A global update on the number of farms, farm size and farmland distribution (Agricultural Development Economics Working Paper 25-14, background paper for The State of Food and Agriculture 2025)
world.smallFarmsShare.note: Share of all farms that are smaller than 2 hectares.

world.smallFarmsLandShare.label: Farmland those small farms work
world.smallFarmsLandShare.source: FAO: Lowder, Arslan, Cabrera Cevallos, O'Neill and De La O Campos, A global update on the number of farms, farm size and farmland distribution (Agricultural Development Economics Working Paper 25-14, background paper for The State of Food and Agriculture 2025)
world.smallFarmsLandShare.note: About 9 % of all farmland. At the other end, farms over 50 ha are under 1 % of farms but work about 75 % of the world's farmland.

world.irrigatedCroplandShare.label: Cropland that is irrigated
world.irrigatedCroplandShare.source: FAO: The State of the World's Land and Water Resources for Food and Agriculture 2021 (SOLAW 2021), synthesis report
world.irrigatedCroplandShare.note: Rounded: irrigated farming grows about 40 % of the world's food on about 20 % of the cultivated land. The older FAO water factsheet named in the concept could not be read, so this report is cited instead.

world.irrigatedFoodShare.label: Food from irrigated land
world.irrigatedFoodShare.source: FAO: The State of the World's Land and Water Resources for Food and Agriculture 2021 (SOLAW 2021), synthesis report
world.irrigatedFoodShare.note: Rounded: rain-fed farming grows the other 60 % on about 80 % of the cultivated land.

world.fields2025.label: Fields mapped for 2025
world.fields2025.source: Fields of The World (FTW): global field boundaries 2024-2025, on Source Cooperative
world.fields2025.note: A machine-learning model (PRUE field-boundary segmentation) drew these outlines from Sentinel-2 satellite images; it is not a count of farms. 1.58 billion for 2025 and 1.63 billion for 2024, across 195 countries and territories.

eu.farms.label: Farms in the EU
eu.farms.source: Eurostat: Farms and farmland in the European Union - statistics (farm structure survey 2023)
eu.farms.note: EU-27, rounded as published: 8.8 million holdings on 156.2 million ha.

eu.meanSizeHa.label: Mean farm size
eu.meanSizeHa.source: Eurostat: Farms and farmland in the European Union - statistics (farm structure survey 2023)

eu.largeFarmsLandShare.label: Land on farms of 50 ha or more
eu.largeFarmsLandShare.source: Eurostat: Farms and farmland in the European Union - statistics (farm structure survey 2023)
eu.largeFarmsLandShare.note: The 7.6 % of EU farms that have 50 ha or more hold 68.3 % of the farmland.

de.farms.label: Farms
de.farms.source: Eurostat: farm structure survey 2023, table ef_m_farmleg (Germany)
de.farms.note: Agricultural holdings. Destatis and the state statistics offices run the survey in Germany.

de.meanSizeHa.label: Mean farm size
de.meanSizeHa.source: Eurostat: farm structure survey 2023, table ef_m_farmleg (Germany)
de.meanSizeHa.note: Farmland divided by farms, both from the same table: 16,585,540 ha / 255,010 = 65.0 ha.

de.uaaHa.label: Farmland
de.uaaHa.source: Eurostat: farm structure survey 2023, table ef_m_farmleg (Germany)
de.uaaHa.note: Utilised agricultural area: arable land, grassland and permanent crops.

de.irrigatedShare.label: Irrigated share
de.irrigatedShare.source: Destatis: press release 186 of 10 May 2024 (irrigation in agriculture, 2022)
de.irrigatedShare.note: About 554,000 ha of open-field farmland were irrigated in 2022, a very dry year.

de.wheatYield.label: Wheat yield
de.wheatYield.source: Destatis: hectare yields of selected crops over time (wheat, all kinds)
de.wheatYield.note: All wheat, winter and spring; 2025 is kept so it compares with Brandenburg's 2025 report. Destatis' table of 24 Sep 2026 also lists 2026: 72.0 dt/ha. 2024: 70.8. 1 dt/ha is 100 kg per hectare.

bb.farms.label: Farms
bb.farms.source: Eurostat: farm structure survey 2023, table ef_m_farmleg (Brandenburg, region DE40)
bb.farms.note: Agricultural holdings. Other counts differ slightly by survey and threshold.

bb.meanSizeHa.label: Mean farm size
bb.meanSizeHa.source: Eurostat: farm structure survey 2023, table ef_m_farmleg (Brandenburg, region DE40)
bb.meanSizeHa.note: Farmland divided by farms, both from the same table: 1,297,550 ha / 5,370 = 241.6 ha, almost four times the German mean.

bb.uaaHa.label: Farmland
bb.uaaHa.source: Eurostat: farm structure survey 2023, table ef_m_farmleg (Brandenburg, region DE40)

bb.largeFarmsLandShare.label: Land on farms of 100 ha or more
bb.largeFarmsLandShare.source: Eurostat: farm structure survey 2023, table ef_m_farmleg (Brandenburg, region DE40)
bb.largeFarmsLandShare.note: Farms of 100 ha or more are 39.5 % of Brandenburg's farms (2,120 of 5,370) and hold 93.3 % of its farmland (1,211,140 of 1,297,550 ha).

bb.wheatYield.label: Wheat yield
bb.wheatYield.source: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg: Statistischer Bericht C II 2 - j/25, harvest of field crops and grassland in Brandenburg 2025
bb.wheatYield.note: All wheat, so it compares with Germany's figure. Winter wheat alone: 63.2 dt/ha. 2019-2024 average: 61.2 (winter wheat 61.7).

bb.rapeseedYield.label: Rapeseed yield
bb.rapeseedYield.source: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg: Statistischer Bericht C II 2 - j/25, harvest of field crops and grassland in Brandenburg 2025
bb.rapeseedYield.note: Rapeseed and turnip rape (Raps und Rübsen), the same category as Germany's 36.4 dt/ha (Destatis, same year). Winter rapeseed alone: 27.6.

bb.irrigatedHa.label: Irrigated area
bb.irrigatedHa.source: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg: press release 71/2024 of 27 May 2024 (30,900 ha irrigated in 2022)
bb.irrigatedHa.note: About 2.4 % of Brandenburg's farmland, against 3.3 % for Germany.

mol.farms.label: Farms in the district
mol.farms.source: Landkreis Märkisch-Oderland, agriculture office: presentation Landwirtschaft MOL 2025 (3 Feb 2026)
mol.farms.licence: No licence stated; figures cited with attribution
mol.farms.note: 457 in 2024 and 538 in 1994. The presentation does not say how farms are counted.

mol.uaaHa.label: Farmland in the district
mol.uaaHa.source: Landkreis Märkisch-Oderland, agriculture office: presentation Landwirtschaft MOL 2025 (3 Feb 2026)
mol.uaaHa.licence: No licence stated; figures cited with attribution
mol.uaaHa.note: 57 % of the district's area; about 4,000 ha lost to other uses in 11 years.

mol.surfaceWaterBan.label: Surface-water ban
mol.surfaceWaterBan.source: Landkreis Märkisch-Oderland: general order under water law (notice of 3 Jul 2020), confirmed in force by press release 38/2026 of 16 Jul 2026
mol.surfaceWaterBan.licence: Official public notice; no licence stated
mol.surfaceWaterBan.note: Bans the permit-free ways of taking water (owner, common and riparian use) from all lakes, rivers and ditches in the district, until revoked. Exceptions: under 10 litres a day per person for non-commercial own use, and firefighting.

oderbruch.waterBalanceMm.label: Yearly water balance
oderbruch.waterBalanceMm.source: Our calculation from the Open-Meteo historical weather API, default 'best_match' model (a blend of ERA5, ERA5-Land and IFS), nearest grid point to 52.65 N, 14.35 E
oderbruch.waterBalanceMm.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo; the free API is for non-commercial use)
oderbruch.waterBalanceMm.note: Rain (587 mm a year) minus the water a reference grass crop would use (747 mm), 30-year average. With ERA5 alone the gap is about 142 mm. In 2018: 445 mm of rain against 893 mm.

oderbruch.medianFieldHa.label: Typical field size
oderbruch.medianFieldHa.source: Our calculation from the Brandenburg subsidy-system (IACS) parcels 2026, Land Brandenburg, as harmonised by Fields of The World
oderbruch.medianFieldHa.note: Median of the 4,784 cropped parcels in the box 14.15-14.65 E, 52.45-52.85 N, which is larger than the Oderbruch; mean 13.9 ha. Hedges, tree rows and set-aside strips are left out. The concept's 6.3 ha could not be reproduced exactly.

prices.wheatEurT.label: Milling wheat price
prices.wheatEurT.source: European Commission, agri-food data portal: cereal prices, Germany
prices.wheatEurT.note: Week of 28 Sep to 4 Oct 2026, four markets: Würzburg 210, Mannheim 226.50, Hamburg 235, Köln 240. Price leaving the silo in wholesale trade, not what the farm is paid. The concept's 210-235 missed Köln.

prices.rapeseedEurT.label: Rapeseed price
prices.rapeseedEurT.source: European Commission, agri-food data portal: oilseed prices, Germany
prices.rapeseedEurT.note: National average for the week of 28 Sep to 4 Oct 2026 (518.84). Price leaving the silo in wholesale trade, not what the farm is paid.
